text: 坐地日行八万里，巡天遥看一千河
pinyin: zuò dì rì xíng bā wàn lǐ, xún tiān yáo kàn yī qiān hé
literal: sit · ground · day · travel · eighty thousand · li, patrol · sky · from afar · see · one thousand · rivers
natural: Sitting on the ground I travel eighty thousand li a day; patrolling the sky, I gaze afar on a thousand rivers

meaning.en: Though we seem still, the turning Earth carries us a vast distance each day; quoted to marvel at the cosmos and at scientific progress.
meaning.zh: 人坐着不动，地球自转也带着人日行八万里，常用来赞叹宇宙广阔与科技的进步。

equivalents: we move even when sitting still

examples.zh: 航天员说，“坐地日行八万里，巡天遥看一千河”不再是神话。
examples.en: The astronaut said '坐地日行八万里，巡天遥看一千河' is no longer a myth.

examples.zh: 天文课上，老师引用“坐地日行八万里，巡天遥看一千河”讲地球自转。
examples.en: In astronomy class the teacher quoted '坐地日行八万里，巡天遥看一千河' to explain Earth's rotation.

origin.source: 毛泽东《七律二首·送瘟神》

story.en: Written in 1958 on hearing that schistosomiasis had been wiped out in Yujiang County; the poet imagines the vast view of a transformed land.
story.zh: 1958年闻余江县消灭血吸虫病而作，诗人由此遥想天地之广。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 世上无难事，只要肯登攀
pinyin: shì shàng wú nán shì, zhǐ yào kěn dēng pān
literal: world · on · no · hard · matter, only · need · willing · climb
natural: Nothing in the world is hard if one is willing to climb

meaning.en: Determination overcomes any difficulty; a popular motto to encourage effort and perseverance.
meaning.zh: 只要肯努力攀登，就没有克服不了的困难，是常见的励志语。

equivalents: where there's a will there's a way
nothing is impossible if you try

examples.zh: 教室墙上贴着“世上无难事，只要肯登攀”。
examples.en: '世上无难事，只要肯登攀' is posted on the classroom wall.

examples.zh: 教练用“世上无难事，只要肯登攀”鼓励队员。
examples.en: The coach used '世上无难事，只要肯登攀' to encourage the team.

origin.source: 毛泽东《水调歌头·重上井冈山》

story.en: Written in 1965 when Mao revisited the Jinggang Mountains, urging people to keep striving.
story.zh: 1965年毛泽东重上井冈山时所作，词中鼓励人们奋发攀登。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 踏遍青山人未老，风景这边独好
pinyin: tà biàn qīng shān rén wèi lǎo, fēng jǐng zhè biān dú hǎo
literal: tread · all · green · hills · person · not yet · old, scenery · this · side · alone · good
natural: Having trodden all the green hills I am not old, and the scenery here is best of all

meaning.en: Optimism and vigour despite long travel; quoted of fresh energy and of places or phases of life that are beautiful.
meaning.zh: 历经跋涉而朝气不减，乐观豪迈，常用来赞美风景独好或人老心不老。

equivalents: the view here is the finest

examples.zh: 爷爷爬了半辈子山，常说“踏遍青山人未老，风景这边独好”。
examples.en: Grandfather has climbed mountains half his life and often says '踏遍青山人未老，风景这边独好'.

examples.zh: 旅游宣传片以“踏遍青山人未老，风景这边独好”做口号。
examples.en: The travel promo used '踏遍青山人未老，风景这边独好' as its slogan.

story.en: Written in 1934 in Huichang, Jiangxi, in a mood of optimism before the Long March began.
story.zh: 1934年毛泽东在江西会昌所作，词意乐观豪迈。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 为有牺牲多壮志，敢教日月换新天
pinyin: wèi yǒu xī shēng duō zhuàng zhì, gǎn jiào rì yuè huàn xīn tiān
literal: because · have · sacrifice · much · lofty · resolve, dare · make · sun · moon · change · new · sky
natural: Because sacrifice breeds lofty resolve, we dare to make sun and moon give way to a new sky

meaning.en: Sacrifice strengthens resolve to remake the world; quoted in praise of heroes and bold reform.
meaning.zh: 牺牲激发壮志，敢于改天换地，常用来歌颂英烈与大胆变革。

examples.zh: 烈士陵园的碑上刻着“为有牺牲多壮志，敢教日月换新天”。
examples.en: '为有牺牲多壮志，敢教日月换新天' is carved on the monument in the martyrs' cemetery.

examples.zh: 改革者喊出“为有牺牲多壮志，敢教日月换新天”的口号。
examples.en: The reformers raised the cry of '为有牺牲多壮志，敢教日月换新天'.

story.en: Written in 1959 on Mao's return to his home village Shaoshan after 32 years.
story.zh: 1959年毛泽东回到阔别三十二年的家乡韶山所作。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 寄意寒星荃不察，我以我血荐轩辕
pinyin: jì yì hán xīng quán bù chá, wǒ yǐ wǒ xuè jiàn xuān yuán
literal: send · intent · cold · stars · fragrant grass (the people) · not · notice, I · with · my · blood · offer · Xuanyuan
natural: I send my heart to the cold stars though the people do not notice; I offer my blood to the Yellow Emperor's land

meaning.en: A vow to give one's life for the nation, even unrecognised; quoted to express patriotism and devotion.
meaning.zh: 立誓为祖国献身，即使不被理解，常用来表达爱国情怀与奉献精神。

equivalents: I will give my life for my country

examples.zh: 青年鲁迅写下“寄意寒星荃不察，我以我血荐轩辕”。
examples.en: The young Lu Xun wrote '寄意寒星荃不察，我以我血荐轩辕'.

examples.zh: 演讲中他用“寄意寒星荃不察，我以我血荐轩辕”表达报国之志。
examples.en: In his speech he used '寄意寒星荃不察，我以我血荐轩辕' to declare his resolve to serve the country.

story.en: Written in 1903 by Lu Xun when he was studying in Japan, as an inscription on his photograph.
story.zh: 1903年鲁迅留学日本时题在自己的照片上。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 度尽劫波兄弟在，相逢一笑泯恩仇
pinyin: dù jìn jié bō xiōng dì zài, xiāng féng yī xiào mǐn ēn chóu
literal: pass through · all · calamity · waves · brothers · still here, meet · one · smile · wipe out · grudge · enmity
natural: Having come through all the calamities, brothers remain; meeting again with a smile, old grievances vanish

meaning.en: After hardship, old rivals reconcile; quoted for reconciliation and forgiveness between nations or people.
meaning.zh: 历经劫难后，兄弟仍在，一笑泯灭旧怨，常用来表达和解与宽恕。

examples.zh: 两国领导人握手时，有人想起“度尽劫波兄弟在，相逢一笑泯恩仇”。
examples.en: As the two leaders shook hands, people recalled '度尽劫波兄弟在，相逢一笑泯恩仇'.

examples.zh: 老同学多年误会，终于“度尽劫波兄弟在，相逢一笑泯恩仇”。
examples.en: After years of misunderstanding, the old classmates finally '度尽劫波兄弟在，相逢一笑泯恩仇'.

story.en: Written in 1933 for the Japanese zoologist Nishimura Makoto, who took a dove from the 1932 Shanghai ruins home to Japan and built the 'Sanyi Pagoda' for it; the poem hopes for friendship between the two peoples.
story.zh: 1933年鲁迅为日本友人西村真琴题诗：西村从1932年上海战火废墟中带回一只鸽子，鸽死后建“三义塔”埋葬；诗中寄望中日人民友好。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 其实地上本没有路，走的人多了，也便成了路
pinyin: qí shí dì shàng běn méi yǒu lù, zǒu de rén duō le, yě biàn chéng le lù
literal: actually · ground · on · originally · not · have · road, walk · [particle] · people · many · [particle], also · then · become · [particle] · road
natural: Actually there was never a road on the ground; when enough people walk it, it becomes one

meaning.en: Paths are made by many people walking; quoted to encourage pioneers and to say that collective effort changes things.
meaning.zh: 路是人走出来的，常用来鼓励开拓者，也说明集体行动能改变现状。

equivalents: a path is made by walking it
if enough people go, a road forms

examples.zh: “其实地上本没有路，走的人多了，也便成了路”，只要有人开头，就会有人跟上。
examples.en: '其实地上本没有路，走的人多了，也便成了路': once someone leads, others will follow.

examples.zh: 考试作文里常引用鲁迅的“其实地上本没有路，走的人多了，也便成了路”。
examples.en: Exam essays often quote Lu Xun's '其实地上本没有路，走的人多了，也便成了路'.

story.en: The closing lines of Lu Xun's story 'My Old Home', in which the narrator reflects on hope after leaving his hometown.
story.zh: 鲁迅小说《故乡》结尾，主人公离乡时对希望的感悟。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 盼望着，盼望着，东风来了，春天的脚步近了
pinyin: pàn wàng zhe, pàn wàng zhe, dōng fēng lái le, chūn tiān de jiǎo bù jìn le
literal: hope · hope, east · wind · come · [particle], spring · [particle] · footsteps · near · [particle]
natural: Longing, longing, the east wind has come and the footsteps of spring are near

meaning.en: The famous opening of Zhu Ziqing's essay 'Spring'; quoted for the arrival of spring and eager anticipation.
meaning.zh: 朱自清散文《春》的开头，常用来描写春天将至和期盼的心情。

equivalents: spring is just around the corner

examples.zh: 天气一回暖，同学们就念起“盼望着，盼望着，东风来了，春天的脚步近了”。
examples.en: As soon as it warmed up, the students recited '盼望着，盼望着，东风来了，春天的脚步近了'.

examples.zh: 作文开头他写了“盼望着，盼望着，东风来了，春天的脚步近了”。
examples.en: He began his essay with '盼望着，盼望着，东风来了，春天的脚步近了'.

story.en: The opening line of the prose piece 'Spring' (1933), a staple of Chinese school textbooks.
story.zh: 散文《春》的开篇，是语文课本中的名篇。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 月光如流水一般，静静地泻在这一片叶子和花上
pinyin: yuè guāng rú liú shuǐ yī bān, jìng jìng dì xiè zài zhè yī piàn yè zi hé huā shàng
literal: moon · light · like · flowing · water · [simile], quietly · -ly · pour · on · this · one · piece · leaves · and · flowers · on
natural: The moonlight, like flowing water, pours quietly over this expanse of leaves and flowers

meaning.en: A famous image of moonlight over a lotus pond; quoted as a model of delicate descriptive prose.
meaning.zh: 描写月光洒在荷塘上的名句，是细腻写景的典范。

examples.zh: 语文老师让大家背诵“月光如流水一般，静静地泻在这一片叶子和花上”。
examples.en: The Chinese teacher asked everyone to memorise '月光如流水一般，静静地泻在这一片叶子和花上'.

examples.zh: 他的散文里有一句“月光如流水一般，静静地泻在这一片叶子和花上”，读来如画。
examples.en: His essay has the line '月光如流水一般，静静地泻在这一片叶子和花上', as vivid as a painting.

story.en: From the essay 'Moonlight over the Lotus Pond' (1927), written one quiet night at Tsinghua University.
story.zh: 1927年朱自清在清华园一个夜晚所写的散文《荷塘月色》。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 燕子去了，有再来的时候；杨柳枯了，有再青的时候；桃花谢了，有再开的时候
pinyin: yàn zi qù le, yǒu zài lái de shí hòu, yáng liǔ kū le, yǒu zài qīng de shí hòu, táo huā xiè le, yǒu zài kāi de shí hòu
literal: swallow · go · [particle], have · again · come · [particle] · time; willow · wither · [particle], have · again · green · [particle] · time; peach blossom · fade · [particle], have · again · bloom · [particle] · time
natural: When the swallows leave, there is a time they return; when the willows wither, there is a time they turn green again; when the peach blossoms fade, there is a time they bloom again

meaning.en: The opening of 'Hurried Passing': nature's things come back, but time does not; quoted to lament fleeting time and urge people to cherish it.
meaning.zh: 《匆匆》开头，自然之物去而复来，唯有时光一去不返，常用来感叹时间飞逝、劝人珍惜。

equivalents: swallows return but time does not

examples.zh: 读了“燕子去了，有再来的时候；杨柳枯了，有再青的时候；桃花谢了，有再开的时候”，他开始珍惜每一天。
examples.en: After reading '燕子去了，有再来的时候；杨柳枯了，有再青的时候；桃花谢了，有再开的时候', he began to cherish each day.

examples.zh: 时间教育课上，老师朗读“燕子去了，有再来的时候；杨柳枯了，有再青的时候；桃花谢了，有再开的时候”。
examples.en: In the time-management class the teacher read out '燕子去了，有再来的时候；杨柳枯了，有再青的时候；桃花谢了，有再开的时候'.

story.en: From the prose essay 'Hurrying' (1922), a lament that time slips away while the seasons return.
story.zh: 1922年散文《匆匆》开头，感叹时光匆匆流逝。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 少年智则国智，少年富则国富，少年强则国强，少年独立则国独立，少年自由则国自由，少年进步则国进步
pinyin: shào nián zhì zé guó zhì, shào nián fù zé guó fù, shào nián qiáng zé guó qiáng, shào nián dú lì zé guó dú lì, shào nián zì yóu zé guó zì yóu, shào nián jìn bù zé guó jìn bù
literal: youth · wise · then · country · wise, youth · rich · then · country · rich, youth · strong · then · country · strong, youth · independent · then · country · independent, youth · free · then · country · free, youth · progressive · then · country · progressive
natural: If the young are wise, the nation is wise; if the young are rich, the nation is rich; if the young are strong, the nation is strong; if the young are independent, the nation is independent; if the young are free, the nation is free; if the young progress, the nation progresses

meaning.en: A rallying call on the young as the future of the nation; quoted in school speeches and youth-day messages.
meaning.zh: 强调青年是国家的未来，常见于校园演讲和青年节寄语。

equivalents: the youth of a nation are its future
as the young go, so goes the nation

examples.zh: 青年节上，团委书记朗读“少年智则国智，少年富则国富，少年强则国强，少年独立则国独立，少年自由则国自由，少年进步则国进步”。
examples.en: On Youth Day the Youth League secretary read out '少年智则国智，少年富则国富，少年强则国强，少年独立则国独立，少年自由则国自由，少年进步则国进步'.

examples.zh: 作文中引用“少年智则国智，少年富则国富，少年强则国强，少年独立则国独立，少年自由则国自由，少年进步则国进步”，显得有气势。
examples.en: Quoting '少年智则国智，少年富则国富，少年强则国强，少年独立则国独立，少年自由则国自由，少年进步则国进步' in an essay gives it force.

story.en: Written by Liang Qichao in 1900 in Japan, urging China to become a young and vigorous nation.
story.zh: 1900年梁启超流亡日本时所作，呼唤“少年中国”的诞生。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 美哉，我少年中国，与天不老；壮哉，我中国少年，与国无疆
pinyin: měi zāi, wǒ shào nián zhōng guó, yǔ tiān bù lǎo, zhuàng zāi, wǒ zhōng guó shào nián, yǔ guó wú jiāng
literal: beautiful · [exclamation], my · young · China, with · heaven · not · age; mighty · [exclamation], my · China · youth, with · nation · without · limit
natural: How beautiful is my Young China, ageless as heaven; how mighty are the youth of China, boundless as the nation

meaning.en: The ending of Liang Qichao's essay, praising a youthful China and its young people; quoted at graduations and youth events.
meaning.zh: 《少年中国说》结尾，赞美少年中国与中国少年，常用于毕业典礼与青年活动。

examples.zh: 毕业典礼最后全场齐诵“美哉，我少年中国，与天不老；壮哉，我中国少年，与国无疆”。
examples.en: At the end of graduation the whole hall recited '美哉，我少年中国，与天不老；壮哉，我中国少年，与国无疆'.

examples.zh: 他把“美哉，我少年中国，与天不老；壮哉，我中国少年，与国无疆”写在笔记本扉页。
examples.en: He wrote '美哉，我少年中国，与天不老；壮哉，我中国少年，与国无疆' on the first page of his notebook.

story.en: The final lines of the essay 'On Young China' (1900).
story.zh: 《少年中国说》（1900）的结尾。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 为天地立心，为生民立命，为往圣继绝学，为万世开太平
pinyin: wèi tiān dì lì xīn, wèi shēng mín lì mìng, wèi wǎng shèng jì jué xué, wèi wàn shì kāi tài píng
literal: for · heaven · earth · establish · heart, for · living · people · establish · destiny, for · past · sages · continue · lost · learning, for · ten-thousand · generations · open · great · peace
natural: To establish a moral heart for heaven and earth, a way of life for the people, to continue the lost teachings of past sages, and to bring lasting peace for all generations

meaning.en: The four aims of the scholar, summing up the Confucian ideal of social responsibility; quoted to express lofty, civic-minded ambition.
meaning.zh: 北宋张载提出的“横渠四句”，概括儒者的社会责任与理想，常用来表达远大抱负。

equivalents: to serve heaven, earth and posterity

examples.zh: 他常把“为天地立心，为生民立命，为往圣继绝学，为万世开太平”当作座右铭。
examples.en: He often takes '为天地立心，为生民立命，为往圣继绝学，为万世开太平' as his motto.

examples.zh: 大学校长在开学典礼上引用“为天地立心，为生民立命，为往圣继绝学，为万世开太平”。
examples.en: The university president quoted '为天地立心，为生民立命，为往圣继绝学，为万世开太平' at the opening ceremony.

story.en: Often called the 'Four Sentences of Hengqu', these words are attributed to the Song Confucian Zhang Zai; versions vary slightly (e.g. 立心 / 立志, 立命 / 立道).
story.zh: 宋代张载之语，即“横渠四句”；不同文献字句略异（如“立心”“立志”，“立命”“立道”）。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 风声雨声读书声，声声入耳；家事国事天下事，事事关心
pinyin: fēng shēng yǔ shēng dú shū shēng, shēng shēng rù ěr, jiā shì guó shì tiān xià shì, shì shì guān xīn
literal: wind · sound · rain · sound · reading · sound, sound · after · sound · enter · ear; family · affairs · state · affairs · world · affairs, affair · after · affair · concern · heart
natural: The sound of wind, rain and reading aloud: every sound enters the ear; family affairs, state affairs, world affairs: every affair concerns the heart

meaning.en: A famous couplet urging scholars to care about the world beyond their books; quoted in school mottoes and essays.
meaning.zh: 著名对联，劝读书人既勤学也关心家国天下，常见于校训和作文。

equivalents: care about the world while you study

examples.zh: 图书馆门口挂着“风声雨声读书声，声声入耳；家事国事天下事，事事关心”。
examples.en: The couplet '风声雨声读书声，声声入耳；家事国事天下事，事事关心' hangs at the library entrance.

examples.zh: 班主任以“风声雨声读书声，声声入耳；家事国事天下事，事事关心”教育学生关心时事。
examples.en: The class teacher used '风声雨声读书声，声声入耳；家事国事天下事，事事关心' to urge students to follow current affairs.

story.en: Couplet by the Ming scholar Gu Xiancheng for the Donglin Academy in Wuxi, where scholars debated politics.
story.zh: 明代顾宪成为无锡东林书院所撰对联。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 有的人活着，他已经死了；有的人死了，他还活着
pinyin: yǒu de rén huó zhe, tā yǐ jīng sǐ le, yǒu de rén sǐ le, tā hái huó zhe
literal: some · people · alive, they · already · dead; some · people · dead, they · still · alive
natural: Some people are alive, yet they are already dead; some people are dead, yet they live on

meaning.en: Meaningful lives outlast death while empty lives are as good as over; quoted in tributes to people who gave their lives for others.
meaning.zh: 有价值的人虽死犹生，庸碌无为者虽生犹死，常用于缅怀、赞颂为他人而奉献的人。

equivalents: a life of meaning outlives its end

examples.zh: 追悼会上，人们想起“有的人活着，他已经死了；有的人死了，他还活着”。
examples.en: At the memorial service people recalled '有的人活着，他已经死了；有的人死了，他还活着'.

examples.zh: 老师以“有的人活着，他已经死了；有的人死了，他还活着”讲什么叫生命的价值。
examples.en: The teacher used '有的人活着，他已经死了；有的人死了，他还活着' to explain the value of life.

story.en: Zang Kejia wrote this poem in 1949 in memory of Lu Xun, contrasting those who live for themselves with those who live for others.
story.zh: 1949年臧克家为纪念鲁迅而作，对比为己与为人的两种人生。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 黑夜给了我黑色的眼睛，我却用它寻找光明
pinyin: hēi yè gěi le wǒ hēi sè de yǎn jīng, wǒ què yòng tā xún zhǎo guāng míng
literal: dark · night · give · [particle] · me · black · [particle] · eyes, I · yet · use · them · seek · light · bright
natural: The dark night gave me black eyes, yet I use them to look for light

meaning.en: Hope that seeks light even in dark times; quoted for optimism in adversity.
meaning.zh: 在黑暗年代依然寻找光明，常用来表达逆境中的乐观与希望。

equivalents: look for the light in the dark

examples.zh: 疫情最难的时候，他在日记里写下“黑夜给了我黑色的眼睛，我却用它寻找光明”。
examples.en: In the hardest days of the epidemic he wrote '黑夜给了我黑色的眼睛，我却用它寻找光明' in his diary.

examples.zh: 海报上印着“黑夜给了我黑色的眼睛，我却用它寻找光明”。
examples.en: The poster is printed with '黑夜给了我黑色的眼睛，我却用它寻找光明'.

story.en: A two-line poem written in 1979 by Gu Cheng, a leading Misty poet, about the generation that grew up in the Cultural Revolution.
story.zh: 朦胧诗人顾城1979年所作的两行短诗，写经历“文革”的一代人。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 轻轻的我走了，正如我轻轻的来；我轻轻的招手，作别西天的云彩
pinyin: qīng qīng de wǒ zǒu le, zhèng rú wǒ qīng qīng de lái, wǒ qīng qīng de zhāo shǒu, zuò bié xī tiān de yún cǎi
literal: gently · [particle] · I · leave · [particle], just · as · I · gently · [particle] · came; I · gently · [particle] · wave · hand, bid farewell · west · sky · [particle] · clouds
natural: Quietly I am leaving, just as quietly I came; I wave gently, bidding farewell to the clouds in the western sky

meaning.en: A graceful, wistful farewell; quoted when leaving a place or a time of life.
meaning.zh: 优雅而略带惆怅的告别，常用于离开某地或某段时光时。

equivalents: leaving as softly as I came

examples.zh: 毕业离校那天，他轻声念起“轻轻的我走了，正如我轻轻的来；我轻轻的招手，作别西天的云彩”。
examples.en: On the day he left school he softly recited '轻轻的我走了，正如我轻轻的来；我轻轻的招手，作别西天的云彩'.

examples.zh: 辞职信的末尾，他引用了“轻轻的我走了，正如我轻轻的来；我轻轻的招手，作别西天的云彩”。
examples.en: At the end of his resignation letter he quoted '轻轻的我走了，正如我轻轻的来；我轻轻的招手，作别西天的云彩'.

story.en: Xu Zhimo wrote 'Saying Goodbye to Cambridge' in 1928 on a visit to the university where he had studied.
story.zh: 1928年徐志摩重访剑桥大学后所作《再别康桥》。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 夫天地者，万物之逆旅也；光阴者，百代之过客也
pinyin: fú tiān dì zhě, wàn wù zhī nì lǚ yě, guāng yīn zhě, bǎi dài zhī guò kè yě
literal: as for · heaven · earth · [topic], ten-thousand · things · [of] · inn · [particle]; light · shade · [topic], hundred · ages · [of] · passing guest · [particle]
natural: Heaven and earth are the inn of all things; time is the passing guest of a hundred generations

meaning.en: The brevity of life against the vastness of the universe; quoted to reflect on time and to justify seizing joy.
meaning.zh: 天地只是万物的旅舍，光阴只是百代的过客，常用来感叹人生短暂、及时行乐。

examples.zh: 除夕夜，他想起“夫天地者，万物之逆旅也；光阴者，百代之过客也”。
examples.en: On New Year's Eve he thought of '夫天地者，万物之逆旅也；光阴者，百代之过客也'.

examples.zh: 散文开头写“夫天地者，万物之逆旅也；光阴者，百代之过客也”，一下子把人带进诗意。
examples.en: The essay opens with '夫天地者，万物之逆旅也；光阴者，百代之过客也', drawing the reader into poetry at once.

story.en: Li Bai's preface to a spring-night banquet among peach and plum blossoms with his cousins.
story.zh: 李白与族弟们春夜宴于桃李园所作序文的开头。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 抽刀断水水更流，举杯销愁愁更愁
pinyin: chōu dāo duàn shuǐ shuǐ gèng liú, jǔ bēi xiāo chóu chóu gèng chóu
literal: draw · sword · cut · water · water · even more · flows, raise · cup · dispel · sorrow · sorrow · even more · sorrowful
natural: Draw a sword to cut the water and it only flows more; raise a cup to drown sorrow and sorrow only grows

meaning.en: Sorrow cannot be cut off or drowned; quoted when trying to escape worry makes it worse.
meaning.zh: 忧愁无法斩断也无法借酒消解，常用来说明越想摆脱烦恼烦恼越多。

equivalents: drowning your sorrows only makes them worse

examples.zh: 失恋后他借酒消愁，可是“抽刀断水水更流，举杯销愁愁更愁”。
examples.en: After the break-up he drank to forget, but '抽刀断水水更流，举杯销愁愁更愁'.

examples.zh: “抽刀断水水更流，举杯销愁愁更愁”，压力大时硬撑只会更糟。
examples.en: '抽刀断水水更流，举杯销愁愁更愁': under pressure, forcing it only makes things worse.

origin.source: 李白《宣州谢朓楼饯别校书叔云》

story.en: From the farewell poem Li Bai wrote at the Xie Tiao Tower in Xuanzhou for his uncle Li Yun.
story.zh: 李白在宣州谢朓楼为族叔李云送行所作。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 云想衣裳花想容，春风拂槛露华浓
pinyin: yún xiǎng yī cháng huā xiǎng róng, chūn fēng fú kǎn lù huá nóng
literal: clouds · think of · robes · flowers · think of · face, spring · breeze · brush · railing · dew · glow · rich
natural: Clouds remind one of her robes, flowers of her face; the spring breeze brushes the rail and the dew glistens thick

meaning.en: A graceful description of a beautiful woman, said of Yang Guifei; quoted to praise beauty and elegance.
meaning.zh: 描写杨贵妃的美丽，常用来赞美女子容貌与风姿。

examples.zh: 影评称赞女主角“云想衣裳花想容，春风拂槛露华浓”。
examples.en: The film review praised the heroine as '云想衣裳花想容，春风拂槛露华浓'.

examples.zh: 古装剧里常配“云想衣裳花想容，春风拂槛露华浓”的台词。
examples.en: Costume dramas often use the line '云想衣裳花想容，春风拂槛露华浓'.

story.en: One of three poems Li Bai wrote in the Tang court at the emperor's request in praise of Consort Yang and peonies.
story.zh: 李白奉唐玄宗之命所作三首《清平调》之一，赞杨贵妃与牡丹。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 五花马，千金裘，呼儿将出换美酒，与尔同销万古愁
pinyin: wǔ huā mǎ, qiān jīn qiú, hū ér jiāng chū huàn měi jiǔ, yǔ ěr tóng xiāo wàn gǔ chóu
literal: five-flower · horse, thousand-gold · fur coat, call · boy · take · out · exchange · fine · wine, with · you · together · dissolve · ten-thousand-ages · sorrow
natural: My dappled horse, my coat worth a thousand pieces of gold: call the boy to trade them for fine wine and drown the age-old sorrow with you

meaning.en: A grand gesture of spending everything to drink and forget sorrow; quoted for reckless generosity and bold feeling.
meaning.zh: 豪迈地拿出最珍贵的东西换酒，与友人共消万古愁，常用来表达豪放不羁。

equivalents: spend it all on wine and friends

examples.zh: 聚会上他拿起酒杯高声念“五花马，千金裘，呼儿将出换美酒，与尔同销万古愁”。
examples.en: At the gathering he raised his glass and declaimed '五花马，千金裘，呼儿将出换美酒，与尔同销万古愁'.

examples.zh: 李白写下“五花马，千金裘，呼儿将出换美酒，与尔同销万古愁”，豪气冲天。
examples.en: Li Bai wrote '五花马，千金裘，呼儿将出换美酒，与尔同销万古愁', full of daring.

story.en: The closing lines of 'Bring in the Wine', written by Li Bai while drinking with friends Cen Xun and Danqiu.
story.zh: 李白与岑勋、元丹丘饮酒时所作《将进酒》的结尾。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 感时花溅泪，恨别鸟惊心
pinyin: gǎn shí huā jiàn lèi, hèn bié niǎo jīng xīn
literal: feel · times · flowers · splash · tears, hate · parting · birds · startle · heart
natural: Grieved by the times, even flowers seem to shed tears; hating parting, even birdsong startles the heart

meaning.en: A mood of sorrow so deep that the scenery itself seems to weep; quoted for grief over troubled times and separation.
meaning.zh: 忧时伤别之情深重，连花鸟似乎也含悲，常用来表达对时局和离别的感伤。

equivalents: even flowers weep in troubled times

examples.zh: 战乱时读到“感时花溅泪，恨别鸟惊心”，格外有感触。
examples.en: Reading '感时花溅泪，恨别鸟惊心' in times of war moves one especially.

examples.zh: 语文课分析“感时花溅泪，恨别鸟惊心”的拟人手法。
examples.en: The Chinese class analysed the personification in '感时花溅泪，恨别鸟惊心'.

story.en: Written in 757 when Du Fu was held in the occupied capital Chang'an during the An Lushan rebellion.
story.zh: 757年安史之乱期间杜甫身陷长安时所作。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 星垂平野阔，月涌大江流
pinyin: xīng chuí píng yě kuò, yuè yǒng dà jiāng liú
literal: stars · hang · flat · plain · broad, moon · surge · great · river · flow
natural: The stars hang low over the broad plain; the moon surges on the flowing great river

meaning.en: A vast night scene by a river; quoted for wide, majestic landscapes and a sense of solitude.
meaning.zh: 描绘江上平野的辽阔夜景，常用来形容壮阔的景象和孤寂之感。

equivalents: a vast night over the river

examples.zh: 夜航长江，眼前正是“星垂平野阔，月涌大江流”。
examples.en: Sailing the Yangtze at night, what lay before me was '星垂平野阔，月涌大江流'.

examples.zh: 摄影师以“星垂平野阔，月涌大江流”为题拍了一组夜景。
examples.en: The photographer shot a night series under the title '星垂平野阔，月涌大江流'.

story.en: Written around 765 while Du Fu sailed down the Yangtze in old age, reflecting on his drifting life.
story.zh: 约765年杜甫晚年乘舟沿长江东下时所作。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 文章千古事，得失寸心知
pinyin: wén zhāng qiān gǔ shì, dé shī cùn xīn zhī
literal: writing · thousand · ages · matter, gain · loss · inch · heart · knows
natural: Writing is a matter for the ages; only the writer's own heart knows its gains and losses

meaning.en: Literature endures for all time, and only the author knows how well it is done; quoted of the seriousness of writing.
meaning.zh: 文章是流传千古的大事，其得失唯作者自己最清楚，常用来说明写作的严肃与甘苦。

equivalents: only the author knows the cost

examples.zh: 作家把“文章千古事，得失寸心知”当作座右铭。
examples.en: The writer takes '文章千古事，得失寸心知' as his motto.

examples.zh: 编辑常说“文章千古事，得失寸心知”，要对文字负责。
examples.en: The editor often says '文章千古事，得失寸心知': one must answer for one's words.

story.en: From Du Fu's poem 'An Impromptu Piece', in which he reflects on literature.
story.zh: 杜甫晚年所作《偶题》，谈论文章与诗学。

date.en: Tang dynasty, second half of 8th c.

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 风急天高猿啸哀，渚清沙白鸟飞回
pinyin: fēng jí tiān gāo yuán xiào āi, zhǔ qīng shā bái niǎo fēi huí
literal: wind · urgent · sky · high · gibbons · howl · mournful, islet · clear · sand · white · birds · fly · circle
natural: The wind is sharp, the sky high, the gibbons' cries mournful; the islet is clear, the sand white, the birds wheel back

meaning.en: A spare, vivid autumn scene by the river; quoted as a model of imagery in regulated verse.
meaning.zh: 秋日江边景象，意象鲜明，是律诗写景的典范。

examples.zh: 老师点评“风急天高猿啸哀，渚清沙白鸟飞回”的对仗工整。
examples.en: The teacher praised the neat parallelism in '风急天高猿啸哀，渚清沙白鸟飞回'.

examples.zh: 登高时想起“风急天高猿啸哀，渚清沙白鸟飞回”。
examples.en: Climbing a height, I thought of '风急天高猿啸哀，渚清沙白鸟飞回'.

story.en: Written in 767 on the Double Ninth in Kuizhou, with the poet old, ill and far from home.
story.zh: 767年重阳节杜甫在夔州登高所作，时年老多病、漂泊异乡。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。
